name: laravel-security-review
title_zh: 上线前拦下 SQL 注入和越权的 Laravel 代
tagline_zh: PR 合入前自动扫控制器、模型、迁移和 Blade，专抓 mass assignment、注入、越权、危险上传。
tagline_en: Scans diffs & PRs for mass assignment, SQLi, IDOR, bad uploads in controllers, models, migrations, Blade. Knows.
desc_en: Review Laravel and PHP code for security defects before it ships. Use when reviewing a diff, a pull request, or a controller, model, route, migration, or Blade template, and whenever the user asks about Laravel security, mass assignment, SQL injection, IDOR, authorization gaps, or unsafe file uploads.
why_zh: 它不跑黑盒扫描，而是按 Laravel 的请求生命周期逐层读代码。
why_en: Reads code along Laravel's request lifecycle, not black-box. Catches Eloquent's loose fill, route-model-binding IDOR—more.
limit_zh: 只审 Laravel/PHP 代码，不覆盖前端、Docker、云配置；需要你提供 diff 或文件路径。
limit_en: Laravel/PHP only; no frontend, Docker, or cloud config. Needs diff or file paths; won't fetch repos. May miss non-standard framework patterns.
title_en: Laravel code reviewer that blocks SQLi & IDOR pre-ship
